courier-relay/protocol-1-receipt-identit: Courier Relay protocol 1 receipt identity and count contract. Applies to the count, summary, and accepted commands (and any later command that dedupes receipts) when protocol "1" is selected explicitly. Source: vendor/protocol-1.md (provider contract) and issue trial-vsf (approved 2026-09-07, owner csells); the accepted command consuming this same contract for an integration partner export was approved in issue trial-mya (2026-09-07, owner csells). Rules: (1) A delivery identity is the pair (account_id, delivery_id); the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a separate delivery. (2) Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: the receipt with the earliest occurred_at UTC instant; equal instants accept the smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order. All other receipts for that identity are duplicates. (3) Accepted receipts keep original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are presented in original input order. (4) occurred_at is RFC3339 with seconds, no fractional seconds, Z or explicit numeric offset; compare as UTC instants (offsets may cross a date boundary). Rationale from the provider: delivery-ID allocation guarantee; account attribution alone does not change it. Protocol selection: omitted "protocol" selects the current protocol; an explicit supported protocol stays supported after a newer current version is introduced. Public suites name a protocol explicitly. History: protocol 1 was the current protocol from trial-vsf until 2026-09-07, when issue trial-3id made protocol 2 current (see courier-relay/protocol-2-receipt-identity); protocol 1 rules are unchanged and remain supported via explicit "protocol":"1". Response shapes: count and summary return exactly {"protocol","accepted_count","duplicate_count"}; accepted returns exactly {"protocol","accepted_count","duplicate_count","receipts"} where receipts is the array of accepted representative receipt objects, unchanged, in original input order, and its counts equal summary for the same request. All report "protocol":"1"; empty receipts give 0/0 (accepted also gives receipts []); a single receipt gives 1/0 (accepted returns it unchanged). Implemented in main.py (accepted_receipts_v1, ACCEPTED_RECEIPTS, select_protocol, dedupe, accepted); verified 2026-09-07 with public_tests/count_1.json, summary_1.json, and accepted_1.json plus manual cases: same delivery_id under two accounts kept separately, earliest-wins within an account, and a three-way cross-offset date-boundary equal-instant tie resolved by smallest record_id, with output in input order and counts matching summary.
courier-relay/protocol-2-receipt-identit: Courier Relay protocol 2 receipt identity contract and current-protocol decision. Applies to count, summary, and accepted (and any later command that dedupes receipts) when "protocol" is omitted or is explicitly "2". Source: provider permanently adopted protocol 2; integration owner approved it as the current protocol in issue trial-3id (approved 2026-09-07, owner csells); the accepted command consuming the same contract was approved in issue trial-76o (2026-09-07, owner csells). Rules: (1) A delivery identity is delivery_id alone, across all accounts; the same delivery_id under another account_id is another receipt of the same delivery. (2) Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: the receipt with the LATEST occurred_at UTC instant; equal instants accept the smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order. All other receipts for that identity are duplicates. (3) Accepted receipts keep original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are presented in original input order. (4) occurred_at is RFC3339 with seconds, no fractional seconds, Z or explicit numeric offset; compare as UTC instants (offsets may cross a date boundary). (5) The agreement applies to the entire supplied receipt set regardless of receipt dates (2020-2099); no persistence across CLI invocations. Rationale from the provider: delivery-ID allocation guarantee; account attribution alone does not change it. Protocol selection as of 2026-09-07: omitted "protocol" selects "2" (CURRENT_PROTOCOL in main.py); explicit "2" selects the same contract; explicit "1" keeps the original protocol 1 contract (see courier-relay/protocol-1-receipt-identity); unsupported values return {"error":"unsupported_protocol"}. Response shapes: count and summary return exactly {"protocol","accepted_count","duplicate_count"}; accepted returns exactly {"protocol","accepted_count","duplicate_count","receipts"} where receipts is the array of accepted representative receipt objects, unchanged, in original input order, and the counts equal summary for the same request. All report the actual protocol used; empty receipts give 0/0 (accepted also gives receipts []); a single receipt gives 1/0 (accepted returns it unchanged). Implemented in main.py (accepted_receipts_v2, ACCEPTED_RECEIPTS, select_protocol, dedupe, accepted); verified 2026-09-07 with public_tests/summary_2.json and public_tests/accepted_2.json plus manual cross-account, latest-wins, cross-offset date-boundary tie, and record_id tie cases.
